false_positives_caught_and_discarded: Header overlap sweep initially returned zero overlaps: Lenis virtualizes scroll, so a tight scrollTo-then-measure loop read pre-scroll positions. Re-measured with settle time and reproduced the defect.
Nearly logged an anchor jump failure from reading scroll-margin-top on the sections; the real offset is scroll-padding-top on html. Clicking all ten anchors showed every heading clears the header.
could_not_test: Real iOS/Android hardware and real touch swipe gestures
Screen readers (VoiceOver, NVDA); semantics checked, announcement not
Horizon typeface (unlicensed, Archivo stand-in); every display headline width will shift, re-measure QA-03 first
External destinations: DoorDash, ezCater, Google Maps, the three social links
Ana's CSP over real HTTPS; tested over http://localhost where HSTS and upgrade-insecure-requests are inert
Performance: no Lighthouse, no throttled network, no Core Web Vitals
verdict_basis: Zero open AA failures and zero horizontal leaks at all nine viewports on every route. The two open findings are low severity image delivery items, neither an AA nor a leak failure.
